input.command:
BUNDLE=$(mktemp -d /tmp/kk-evidence-XXXXXX) && echo "BUNDLE=$BUNDLE" && git show eval-release:provider/settings.py > "$BUNDLE/provider_settings_eval-release.py" && REV=$(git rev-parse eval-release) && BLOB=$(git rev-parse eval-release:provider/settings.py) && echo "=== provider/settings.py @ eval-release ===" && cat "$BUNDLE/provider_settings_eval-release.py" && echo "=== PROVENANCE ===" && printf 'repo: %s
revision(tag eval-release): %s
original_path: provider/settings.py
blob_sha: %s
' "$(basename $PWD)" "$REV" "$BLOB" > "$BUNDLE/manifest.txt" && cat "$BUNDLE/manifest.txt" && wc -l "$BUNDLE/provider_settings_eval-release.py"
input.description: Extract eval-release provider source into evidence bundle
